description_en: Retrieves a client certificate or server certificate by its unique identifier
description_zh: 通过证书的唯一识别码查询单个客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息
name: DescribeClientCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the client certificate or server-side certificate to query.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465990.html to query the unique identifiers of all client certificates and server-side certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的唯一识别码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465990.html查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: identifier

Certificate.description_en: The details of the client certificate or server-side certificate
Certificate.description_zh: 客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration date of the certificate. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
AfterDate.description_zh: 证书的到期日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Algorithm.description_en:

ECC: the ECC algorithm.

RSA：表示RSA算法。
ECC：表示ECC算法。
SM2：表示SM2（国密）算法

AliasName.description_en: The alias of the issued certificate

BeforeDate.description_en: The issuance date of the certificate. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
BeforeDate.description_zh: 证书的签发日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

CertificateType.description_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

CLIENT: a client certificate.

SERVER: a server-side certificate
CertificateType.description_zh:

SERVER：表示服务端证书

CommonName.description_en: The common name of the certificate

CustomIdentifier.description_en: The custom identifier, which is a unique key
CustomIdentifier.description_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键

Days.description_en: The validity period of the certificate. Unit: days

Id.description_en: The ID of the data source to which the certificate order belongs

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate

KeySize.description_en: The key length of the certificate

Locality.description_en: The city where the subject organization is located
Locality.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在城市的名称

Md5.description_en: The MD5 fingerprint of the certificate

Organization.description_en: The organization associated with the certificate of the issuing subordinate CA
Organization.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构的名称

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The organizational unit of the certificate subject
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构下部门的名称

ParentIdentifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the subordinate CA certificate that issued the certificate
ParentIdentifier.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书的唯一识别码

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the certificate belongs

Sans.description_en:
The Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension of the certificate. The SAN extension indicates other domain names or IP addresses that are associated with the certificate.

This parameter is a string that is converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a struct that corresponds to a SAN extension. Each SAN extension struct contains the following parameters:

Type: The type of the extension. This parameter is of the Integer type. Valid values:

1: an email address.

2: a domain name.

6: a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).

7: an IP address.

Value: The content of the extension. This parameter is of the String type
Sans.description_zh:
证书的SAN（Subject Alternative Name）扩展属性，表示证书关联的其他域名、IP地址等。

该参数使用JSON数组转化的字符串表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，对应一个SAN扩展。
每个SAN扩展结构体包含以下参数：

Type：Integer类型，表示扩展的类型。取值：
1：表示邮箱地址。
2：表示域名。
6：表示统一资源标志符URI（Uniform Resource Identifier）。
7：表示IP地址。
Value：String类型，表示扩展的内容

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the certificate

Sha2.description_en: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate

SignAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm of the certificate

State.description_en: The state or province where the subject organization is located
State.description_zh:
<props="china">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

ISSUE: The certificate is issued.

REVOKE: The certificate is revoked
Status.description_zh:
证书的状态。取值：

ISSUE：表示正常签发。
REVOKE：表示已被吊销

SubjectDN.description_en:
The subject Distinguished Name (DN) of the certificate. This value is composed of the following fields:

C: Country.

O: Organization.

OU: Organizational unit.

CN: Common name.

<props="china">

ST: The province, municipality, or autonomous region.

</props>


<props="intl">

ST: Province or state.

</props>


CN: Common name
SubjectDN.description_zh:
证书的DN（Distinguished Name）属性，表示证书的使用者，具体包含以下信息：

C：国家。
O：组织机构。
OU：部门。
L：城市。
<props="china">- ST：省份、直辖市或自治区。</props>
<props="intl">- ST：省份或州。</props>
CN：公用名

UploadFlag.description_en: Indicates whether the certificate is synchronized to Digital Certificate Management Service
UploadFlag.description_zh: 表示该证书是否已同步到数字证书服务
